SMTO-EXE-0214 — This PDF wasn't proven safe to share after redaction

GUID: fb550c15-0fba-5445-b48f-08ac85586eab
Slug: pdf-redaction-verification-failed
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • A check showed that sensitive content may still be in this PDF. SMTO can't remove or verify it, so treat the file as unredacted.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Don't send or publish any PDF connected to this error. The content you wanted removed may still be readable inside the file.
  2. Redact the original document with a PDF program that has a true redaction feature, then search the new file for a removed word. Only a tool that permanently deletes content, followed by your own check, makes the file safe to share.
  3. Select Copy error details and note what you asked SMTO to do. SMTO doesn't currently offer redaction, and this message does not establish how the check ran, so someone needs to look into it.

What success looks like

  • A copy redacted with a dedicated tool shows no trace of the removed words when searched.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details and your request to the person who manages SMTO. Keep the unverified file private until the issue is resolved.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A PDF redaction-verification failure was reported; current PDF capabilities include no redaction implementation, so any output tied to it is unverified.

What this means

  • A redaction-verification-failed identity is retained for compatibility, but current PDF capabilities expose no redaction implementation or direct producer for that verdict. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • A redaction-verification-failed identity is retained for compatibility, but current PDF capabilities expose no redaction implementation or direct producer for that verdict.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the historical output's actual verification evidence and current unsupported redaction capability without claiming which hidden data remains.

How to fix it

  • pdf.redaction_verification_failed is retained for compatibility; current PdfService has no redaction producer and readiness() reports redaction unavailable. Withhold any output associated with this result, redo redaction with a separately verified secure-redaction tool, and report how this error was produced, since it indicates an unexpected code path.
  • Withhold unverified output and use a separately supported secure-redaction workflow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Do not release the output; use a separately verified secure redaction workflow.

How to verify the fix

  • A separately verified secure-redaction workflow establishes the release criteria.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
